answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 22821 Country: India Title: I am Syed Ejaz Hussain from Chennai. I have a question regarding property division. I went through previous answers but was not satisfied, hence I am getting in touch with you. Question: Father had purchased a flat measuring 645 sq.ft and expired without assigning any nominee. As of now property is still in his name and not transferred to any name. We are three members in family left i.e Mother, Me and Sister. Would appreciate to know how this could be divided as per islamic law? Question: I am Syed Ejaz Hussain from Chennai. I have a question regarding property division. I went through previous answers but was not satisfied, hence I am getting in touch with you. Question: Father had purchased a flat measuring 645 sq.ft and expired without assigning any nominee. As of now property is still in his name and not transferred to any name. We are three members in family left i.e Mother, Me and Sister. Would appreciate to know how this could be divided as per islamic law? Answer ID: 22821 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! After due rights preceding inheritance, all the property of your father shall be divided into 24 shares. Out of which 3 shares shall go to your mother, 7 shares to you sister and 14 shares to you. Detail: Wife: 3 Daughter: 7 Son 14 Total: 24 Shares Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
